text:
### Observed differences

- The three-activity group A31, A32, A37 changed from optional to near-universal and moved earlier: before, each appeared in about 46 in 100 traces at a mean event position around 0.59 (in the later half, after A21); in the later window each appears in about 99.5 in 100 traces at a mean position around 0.40 (directly after A20). [POS006, POS007, POS008]
- A20's routing changed completely: before, its outgoing transitions went exclusively to A23; in the later window they go to A31, A32 or A37 (roughly one third each) and only rarely directly to A23 (about 0.5 in 100). [DIR001]
- A23 now sits later: before it immediately followed A20 (a gap of 1 position in all traces); in the later window it follows four positions after A20, with the three group activities in between (a gap of 4 in about 99.5 in 100 traces). [LAG001]
- The order around the group flipped: before, A21 and A23 preceded A31/A32/A37 in the traces where the group occurred (about 46 in 100); in the later window the group precedes A21 and A23 in about 99.5 in 100 traces. [REL006, REL007, REL008, REL014, REL015, REL016]
- A22 changed from an optional alternative to mandatory: before it appeared in about 54 in 100 traces and never in the same trace as the group (A22 and A31 co-occurred in 0 traces); in the later window it is in all traces and co-occurs with the group, which precedes it, in about 99.5 in 100 traces. [POS003, REL011, REL012, REL013]
- A21's routing narrowed: before, about 54 in 100 of its outgoing transitions went to A22 and the rest into the group; in the later window all of them go to A22. [DIR002]
- Downstream convergence changed: before, A31, A32 and A37 each led on to A26 (roughly 29 to 36 in 100 of their outgoing transitions); in the later window they lead to A23 or to one another, and A26 is now always reached after A22 (the A21-to-A26 gap is 2 in all traces, versus a mix of gaps 2 and 4 before). [DIR003, DIR004, DIR005, REL010, LAG002]
- Within the group, the order stayed unfixed: A31, A32 and A37 appear in both orders in similar proportions in both windows; what changed is their co-occurrence, from about 46 in 100 traces to about 99.5 in 100. [REL020, REL021, REL022]

### Inference

Support level: Supported hypothesis

The evidence supports the possibility that the previously optional group A31, A32, A37 became a mandatory segment executed directly after A20 and before A23: before, it ran in about 46 in 100 cases after A21 as an alternative to A22; in the later window it runs in about 99.5 in 100 cases between A20 and A23, A22 is executed in every case, and A26 is always reached via A22. [DIR001, LAG001, POS006, REL006, REL011]

This is shown directly by relational evidence (co-occurrence and order flips between the group and A20, A21, A22 and A23), by the successor changes at A20, A21 and the group activities, and by the A20-to-A23 gap change; the screening found 37 qualifying control-flow items against about 0.33 expected without change, far beyond what an unchanged process produces, although many items describe the same underlying restructuring rather than independent confirmations. Limitations: positions are event positions rather than clock time, and the evidence cannot rule out that the later window is dominated by a pre-existing rare variant rather than a modified flow. [screening, REL020, POS003]

Other differences: A20's mean position shifted slightly earlier (about 0.36 to 0.34) and A26's slightly later (about 0.63 to 0.66), consistent with the restructuring above rather than separate changes. [POS001, POS005]
